Exact decision: preserve private-launch and security-sensitive release gates; allow only bounded reversible growth that adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, data collection, or cross-site behavior. Missing evidence is not a clean result or certification.

Complete dated read-only evidence for access boundaries, secrets handling, runtime isolation, release/deploy controls, dependencies and supply chain, TLS, data exposure, monitoring, incident response, and security.txt/disclosure readiness. Do not retrieve credentials, access private containers, exploit targets, change permissions, add dependencies, deploy, or request duplicate telemetry.
